manual_review.tls: tls.py implements locally generated RSA/X.509 identity and independently pinned SHA-256 controller trust with standard cryptography APIs; these are local design choices, not claims about vendor-generated certificates or keys. No device firmware was consulted. General interoperability acceptance remains bounded by the referenced live reconnect records.
manual_review.limits: Local configuration keys, defensive size limits and standard TLS/HTTP choices are not automatically manufacturer facts. Tests do not recognize every future semantic protocol change; contributors must extend the reviewed inventory.
manual_review.project_decisions: Five explicitly project-defined/non-vendor entries use public_documentation for the project's own public specification. They are not counted as device observations or independent evidence of manufacturer requirements; fact_kind and native_observation preserve that distinction.
